reform.lever: SBD GCC 51–52 (advance payment, securities); FIDIC 2017 cl. 4.2, 14.2
reform.reform: Prescribed bond wording (URDG 758) with a notice-and-cure period before any call and reasons stated in the demand; release dates tied to taking-over and reduction of advance-payment security as it is recovered.

reform.lever: PPDA Act ss. 89–91 (administrative review) and Regulations 2023; SBD ITB
reform.reform: Standstill period and written reasons before award; publish evaluation reports; tighter review timelines so challenges are resolved before contract signature.
Cap on liquidated damages and a stated daily rate; set-off only after EOT determination.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 28, 44 (EOT, compensation events); FIDIC 2017 cl. 8.5, 20.2
reform.reform: Programme updates as a contract obligation; EOT determination deadline for the project manager; compensation events list.
Deadlines for the statement at completion and final statement with deemed acceptance if the engineer does not respond.
Pandemic and government-measure events listed expressly, with cost/time consequences.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 42–43 (payment certificates, payments); FIDIC 2017 cl. 14.6–14.8
reform.reform: Fixed certification and payment periods with deemed certification on default; automatic financing charges on late payment at a stated rate; consider statutory security-of-payment adjudication for public works.

reform.lever: SBD fraud & corruption provisions; FIDIC 2017 cl. 15.6
reform.reform: Integrity pact and audit rights in the SBD; explicit consequences and evidential standard for termination for corruption.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 59–60 (termination, payment on termination); FIDIC 2017 cl. 15–16
reform.reform: Closed list of fundamental breaches, mandatory notice-to-correct with cure period, and a valuation formula at termination.
Written variation orders with valuation before execution; cap on oral instructions.
Fee scales and payment milestones for consultants; professional indemnity requirements.

reform.lever: SBD GCC (possession of site; compensation events); FIDIC 2017 cl. 2.1; Roads Act 2019
reform.reform: Land acquisition and resettlement completed before award; late site possession as an automatic compensation event.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 34–35 (defects); FIDIC 2017 cl. 11; Building Control Act 2013 / Regs 2020
reform.reform: Joint defects inspection at taking-over; link building-control inspection records to the contract's defects regime.

tier.reform: Standing adjudicator named at award with fixed decision times and interim-binding decisions; clear 'condition precedent' wording so courts apply the tier consistently (Stage 8: tiers argued in 15% of decisions, enforced in 17%).

model.term: neighbouring districts, previous year (per decision, average)
